description: [WRITE] Write up to 25 put or delete operations across one or more tables in a single call. Accepts both PascalCase (PutRequest/DeleteRequest) and snake_case (put_request/delete_request) keys. Duplicate keys across operations are rejected. ReturnItemCollectionMetrics: SIZE returns partition collection size for tables with LSIs.

request_items.description: Map of table name to array of write requests. Each request is either {put_request: {item: ...}} or {delete_request: {key: ...}}. Max 25 operations total.

return_consumed_capacity.description: What consumed capacity to return: TOTAL for the operation's total, INDEXES for the total broken down by table and index, or NONE (the default) for none. Figures follow DynamoDB's charging rules and match what the DynamoDB API returns for the same request.

name: batch_write_item
